inventory.bulk.confirm_body: {days} day(s) × {rooms} room type(s) = {cells} cells will be updated.
inventory.bulk.rate_needs_contract: To change rates, choose a contract in the grid scope first.
inventory.bulk.rate_warning: Rate changes are written to a draft contract version. Guests keep seeing the current prices until the draft is published.
inventory.bulk.title: Bulk update
inventory.caption: Rates and availability from {from} to {to}. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to edit.
inventory.cell.effective_hint: Effective values combine every matching scope. The form below shows what is set at exactly this scope.
inventory.choose_contract_hint: Choose a contract to see and edit its rates. Without a contract, restrictions apply hotel-wide.
inventory.draft_notice: The contract has an unpublished draft ({v}). Draft rates are shown with a pencil and are not sold until published.
inventory.h.cta: Guests cannot arrive on these dates.
inventory.h.ctd: Guests cannot depart on these dates.
inventory.h.manual_adjustment: Rooms added (+) or taken out (−), e.g. −2 for rooms out of order.
inventory.h.max_advance: Maximum days between booking and arrival.
inventory.h.min_advance: Minimum days between booking and arrival.
inventory.h.oversell: Rooms that may be sold above capacity. Keep 0 unless agreed.
inventory.h.release: Stop selling this many days before arrival (0 = no rule).
inventory.h.stop_sell_mode: Which nights the stop blocks: whole stays through the date, arrivals only or departures only.
inventory.legend.keys: Move between cells, open the editor
inventory.legend.title: Legend
inventory.no_rooms: This hotel has no active room types.
inventory.no_version: This contract has no published version yet, so it has no selling rates.
inventory.read_only: You can view this cell but not change it.
inventory.result.draft_body: Review the draft and publish it to start selling the new rates.
inventory.result.draft_title: Rates saved to draft {v} — not on sale yet
inventory.scope.label: Scope
inventory.section.inventory_hint: Applies to the room type's inventory pool (shared by all room types in the pool) for every contract.
inventory.section.rate_hint: Rates are contract terms: changes go into a draft version and are sold only after it is published.
inventory.section.rate_hint_bulk: Changes the {basis} of the selected rooms and dates in a draft version of the contract. Derived rooms that you do not select keep following their base room.
inventory.section.rate_hint_cell: Changes the {basis} for this night in a draft version of the contract. Publish the draft to sell it.
inventory.section.restrictions_hint: Saved for the selected scope. More specific scopes (contract, room, rate plan, market, channel) win over broader ones.
inventory.subtitle: Availability, restrictions and contract rates by day. Click a cell or press Enter to edit it.
